profile.name: Jeremy Edberg
profile.summary: I like working on challenging projects that no one has done before, usually involving the quick absorption of new information and synthesizing that into creative, effective, and cost-efficient solutions. Knowing a system from top to bottom and being able to leverage that knowledge to improve it is my best skillset. I also enjoy mentoring people and fostering their talents. Specialties: Engineering Leadership, Product Development, Cloud Computing, Chaos Engineering, Distributed Systems, Virtualization, Unix/Linux Administration, Security, General Technical Operations, Web Development, Scalable/Reliable Systems, Web Architectures, Web Services, Systems Management

descriptions: Architect paired with a Director for the Alexa Operational Excellence team to make her faster, more
reliable, more accurate, and more efficient, and improve overall customer experience. A combination of
DevOps and MLOps. Currently solving the problem, "How do you measure the accuracy of a stochastic
AI system?". Part of the primary contact team between AWS and Alexa. Designed and shepherded
observability tools for a real-time, reactive system, reducing Alexa latency by 12% annually. Filed two
speech-processing related patents.
We made a SQL interface to manage your cloud. Shut down the company after two open source
programs dropped doing the same thing. It's hard to compete with free!
We ran your cloud infrastructure so you didn't have to. Made CI/CD tools and did consulting.
Successfully exited.
We joke that we are a logging company that plays movies, my job is to make that truer. Answer the
question “How do we collect and store our data to make it easiest for our Engineers to produce, utilize
and consume?” Make data a 1st class citizen at Netflix. Hone the data story from the beginning of the
Jeremy Edberg - page1pipeline to the end. Align our data story throughout the company. Create and evangelize data best
practices. Discover and disseminate data patterns and anti-patterns. Curate the Netflix Data Platform
Design systems to scale and deliver a great experience, and make sure that when someone wants to
play a movie on Netflix, they can.
Founding member of Netflix's first SRE team. Primary technical contact between AWS and Netflix.
Created the role of Chaos Engineer.
Work throughout the company evangelizing best practices for reliability and resilient architecture. Be
the call leader for major outages driving a quick resolution and alleviating customer impact as quickly
as possible. Write tools (generally in Python) to improve reliability and information flow throughout the
company. Help with hiring and recruiting. During my tenure the team grew to 11 members and reliability
increased by an order of magnitude.
Advisor to member startups; provide domain knowledge and expertise in the areas of operations and
scaling as well as product and social media marketing.

workExperiences.jobTitle: First Engineering Hire/Founding DevOps Engineer/Interim CTO
descriptions: Moved reddit from the datacenter to the cloud. We were the first major website hosted fully on AWS. I
was the primary technical contact between AWS and reddit. Managed the entire engineering team after
the departure of the founders and other founding engineers, and grew the engineering team 3x in that
time.
Responsible for all technology including system architecture, hiring, managing all engineers, capacity
planning, budgeting, operations, vendor relations, and keeping costs down by maximizing automation
while minimizing infrastructure. Involved in the design and testing of all major site features, marketing,
determining new product directions and ideas, writing open source code, promotion, management of
a 18M+ user community, and all other aspects of running reddit.com, an Alexa global top 100 website
with one of the largest Pylons installations on the internet. Oversaw a 30X traffic growth.
Required to be an expert on how the system works end-to-end and learn and integrate new
technologies quickly. Represent reddit at major conferences as an expert in virtualized environments
(aka Cloud Computing) and rapid website scaling.
Jul 2006 - May 2007 (11 months)
Jeremy Edberg - page2Assist the product development team by maintaining their test lab and performing product evaluations
to certify products for inclusion in the eBay platform. Primary focus was Solaris/Unix administration and
network configuration. Also administering IBM Bladecenters, Netscalers, F5's, XServ Raids and myriad
other specialty hardware.
Developing fraud detection and prevention software; investigating computer crime; developing
investigation tools; and serving as a security consultant for the entire organization as well as customers.
Developing, deploying and maintaining eBay Inc.'s IDS's and log aggregation in order to protect eBay
customer data. Granted multiple security related patents for this work.
All around network/firewall/unix/windows admin.
Developing timelines and executing on special projects as necessary. Major project was coordinating
and setting up the technical aspects of running the student elections, enabling 20,000 students to vote
for class officers.
